items.titleZh: 据报道 OpenAI 降低了新一轮融资目标
items.titleEn: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
items.summaryZh: TechCrunch AI 报告了人工智能领域的业务发展。消息来源要点：OpenAI 最新一轮融资似乎没有达到预期。

items.titleZh: 人工智能领域的知名人士正在支持一种选择退出抓取的新方式
items.titleEn: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
items.summaryZh: The Verge AI 报道了人工智能的行业发展。消息来源的要点：正如搜索引擎圆桌会议早些时候报道的那样，OpenAI、谷歌、微软和 Anthropic 表示，他们将采用一种新标准，出版商可以使用该标准来选择不被人工智能抓取。
items.summaryEn: The Verge AI reports an industry development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI, as reported earlier by Search Engine Roundtable.
items.overviewZh: The Verge AI 发布了关于“人工智能领域的知名人士正在支持一种选择退出抓取的新方式”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: The Verge AI published a new update about “The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping”.

items.titleZh: 让网站更容易表达人工智能训练偏好
items.titleEn: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 博客报道了人工智能的行业发展。来源要点：OpenAI 将尊重共享的 robots.txt 信号，以帮助网站运营商向参与的提供商传达他们的 AI 培训偏好。
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Blog reports an industry development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.
items.overviewZh: OpenAI 博客发布了关于“让网站更容易表达 AI 训练偏好”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: OpenAI Blog published a new update about “Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences”.

items.titleZh: 走进全方位：开发人员如何利用前沿人工智能代理将想法转化为模拟
items.titleEn: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
items.summaryZh: NVIDIA 博客报道了人工智能的行业发展。来源要点：将模拟想法转变为可行的应用程序意味着组装资源、连接物理和渲染，并检查场景是否按预期运行。
items.summaryEn: NVIDIA Blog reports an industry development in AI. Key point from the source: Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended.
items.overviewZh: NVIDIA 博客发布了有关“走进全方位宇宙：开发人员如何利用前沿 AI 代理将想法转化为模拟”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: NVIDIA Blog published a new update about “Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents”.
